title: Chumor 2.0: Towards Benchmarking Chinese Humor Understanding

task.approximation: the paper's exact gpt-4-turbo snapshot is not stated (alias rule gives 2024-04-09)

items.source: MichiganNLP/Chumor (gated: access must be requested on the dataset page), file test.tsv; project page dnaihao.github.io/Chumor-dataset; code github.com/dnaihao/Chumor-dataset

fields.input: joke text and explanation text (column names not visible without access; expected joke / explanation)
fields.label: binary label good (fully explains) / bad (partially or does not explain)

prompt.source_location: Sec. 4 'Direct Prompting (DP)' and Appendix E (identical text)
prompt.verbatim: full (PDF character spacing inside the Chinese text removed; line wraps re-joined)

output.parse: label from set ['完全解释', '部分/没有解释']: first occurrence of either string in the reply (also accept '部分解释' or '没有解释' as the bad class)
output.postprocess: strip; '完全解释' -> good, otherwise bad; replies with neither string counted as incorrect

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: fraction of the 3,339 instances whose predicted class (good/bad) equals the human label
metric.original_location: Sec. 5 text and Figure 1 / Table 4 (Appendix F), GPT-4turbo, DP setting (CoT 51.3)

open_points: The Hugging Face dataset MichiganNLP/Chumor is gated: a human must request and obtain access, then confirm the test.tsv column names and the label encoding (prompt and parse are ready).
notes: The paper's dataset link (huggingface.co/datasets/dnaihao/Chumor) redirects to MichiganNLP/Chumor. Table 4 (Appendix F) also gives FPR/FNR/MCC for the same run. || [hook pass 2026-09-07] no hook possible (gated data).
